parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas, card surfaces, light-section backgrounds — a warm ivory that reads as paper, not screen

ink.$description: Ink — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, heading strokes, dark surface accents — near-black used wherever ink is too harsh

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary body copy, subdued borders, caption-level metadata

iron.$description: Iron — Tertiary text and dividers between smoke and graphite

verdigris-wash.$description: Verdigris Wash — Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Soft card surface tint for product preview panels and link highlights — a desaturated cool blue that lives in the background, never the foreground

pewter-haze.$description: Pewter Haze — Muted placeholder tint on empty illustration frames and disabled control fills

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

rhymes-display.$description: Display headlines and hero serif. The whisper-weight 300 cut at 88px is the signature move — most legal-tech sites shout in bold sans, Legora murmurs in light serif. The tight -0.02em tracking pulls letters together so the display reads as one continuous voice, not as individual glyphs.

suisse-intl.$description: Primary body and UI text. The 450-book weight at 16px with -0.01em tracking is the workhorse — a humanist sans tuned for long-form legal copy. The 500-medium cut at 13px is reserved for input values and small emphasis labels. The negative leading (0.80) on small sizes tightens tight UI like eyebrow labels and tags.

aktiv-grotesk-vf.$description: Section subheads and longer body paragraphs where a slightly more neutral grotesk reads cleaner than Suisse Int'l's warmth
